# Jev advisor fixtures

`fixed_pass.json` is synthetic boundary data for runner verification. Its
`source_manifest[0].sha256` is the supplied design document's byte hash;
`source_hash` is the SHA-256 of the canonical manifest. Neither is proof of an R19
hardware run. In particular, this fixture must never be cited as Mission Planner,
E220, COM, firmware, or 30-second HIL acceptance evidence.
